reported_predecessors.provenance: Identifiers reported by the user from the CUDA server; independently reverify source artifacts there.

unchanged_training.initialization: frozen representation best.pt; fresh seed-specific policy, not smoke weights
unchanged_training.candidate_budget: causal P30 token credit; Fast and independent L7-L12; no forced layer diversity or spending
unchanged_training.selection: masked-argmax tune macro AUC subject to P30; tie by lower descriptive latency, then earlier step; report all seeds

unchanged_analysis.primary_accuracy_rule: Average the three selected policies per physical video, then require paired video-bootstrap 95% lower bounds above zero against both primary comparators; development screen only.
unchanged_analysis.mechanism_requirements: gamma=0 and retrained no-memory ablations remain necessary before claiming long-term credit or memory contributions.
unchanged_analysis.efficiency_requirements: The representation resource audit remains failed. Candidate-call savings are not latency savings; learned-policy speed requires a separate interleaved end-to-end audit.

execution.order: sequential on one GPU; stop on an execution error
execution.failure_rule: Repair implementation errors with an explicit new code contract as needed; do not retune hyperparameters, extend the budget, or select a winning seed based on outcomes.
